daily.today_energy: Your vibe is communicative and curious today, Gemini. There's a restless energy pushing you to explore something new—lean into it. This is your moment to ask questions and connect dots others might miss.
daily.love: Whether single or partnered, authenticity is your love language rn. Stop overthinking the small stuff and just be real with someone. The right people vibe with your actual self, not a filtered version.
daily.career: Your ideas are flowing, and people are actually listening. This is a solid day to pitch that thing you've been sitting on or have a real conversation with someone who matters professionally. Trust your instincts.
daily.health: Your nervous system could use some grounding today. Try something tactile—journaling, a walk outside, or just putting your phone down for an hour. Your body's asking for presence, not productivity.

weekly.overview: Mercury's direct energy has you buzzing this week, twin. Your communication channels are wide open and people are actually listening. Lean into conversations that matter and don't sleep on the creative ideas flowing through your mind right now.
weekly.love: If you're coupled up, this is your week to be vulnerable in that specific way only Gemini knows how—thoughtful but playful. Single? Someone's been noticing your energy. The vibe shift is real and it's attracting the right kind of attention your way.
